orgId.description: The organisation joined, null for an English9x invitation

actorEmail.description: Looked up now; null when the account no longer exists

actorKind.description: USER, or OPERATOR for what was done outside the application

actorName.description: Looked up now; null when the account no longer exists

detail.description: Facts about the action. Plain data: show it as text.

invitedEmail.description: For a record about an invitation: the invited address, read from the invitation now (the log does not keep it, so that erasing the invitation erases it); null once the invitation is gone

orgId.description: The context the actor was in; null = English9x (for the actor kind OPERATOR: outside the application)

seq.description: The log's own order: larger = later

googleEnabled.description: false when Google sign-in is not configured: hide the button

contextOrgId.description: The organisation the server applied to THIS request (null = personal)

file.description: the file; its type is read from its bytes

Problem.description: RFC 7807 problem details; errors[] lists invalid fields/rows, empty otherwise

detail.description: Explanation for this occurrence; never contains internals

type.description: URN identifying the problem class, e.g. urn:e9x:problem:validation-failed

field.description: Path of the offending value in the request, e.g. rows[1].sku

row.description: Zero-based index of the offending list element, null when not row-specific

examCode.description: IELTS | TOEIC; required for AUTHOR, REVIEWER, TEACHER, absent for the others

parameters.description: the exam the file is for; the caller must be an AUTHOR of it in the current context
parameters.name: examCode

post.summary: Upload an audio, image or video file for an exam
